newsitem.title: CANADA: Canada Agriculture Minister Goodale re-elected.
newsitem.headline: Canada Agriculture Minister Goodale re-elected.

text.p: Canadian Agriculture Minister Ralph Goodale was re-elected in his Saskatchewan district in Monday's general election, the Canadian Press news agency reported.

Goodale has been at the forefront of a battle over whether the Canadian Wheat Board's monopoly in exporting Canadian grain should be removed to allow western farmers the right to market their crops independently. ((Reuters Calgary Bureau (403) 531-1624))
